integrity: Direct exhaustive finite calculations support but do not prove the limit. The proof is by Poisson conditioning and lattice local limit estimates. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic total-variation convergence without a finite-rate bound. The underlying star-monoid decomposition is already in Fernandes–Paulista and is credited; the probability limit is the assessed new claim. Historical priority relative to broad labelled-assembly limit theorems remains a risk.
title: Poisson–Bernoulli deficiency law for involutive partial star isometries
